title: Frigidaire FF — Clean Filter Reminder
shortDescription: Frigidaire Air Conditioner error FF: The unit is asking the user to clean the air filter after a programmed runtime.
fullDescription: Error code FF on Frigidaire air conditioners indicates the unit is asking the user to clean the air filter after a programmed runtime. This condition normally locks out cooling or heating until the fault is cleared. Common causes include a defective air filter, a loose or damaged wiring harness between the component and the main control board, or a failure of the control board itself. Begin with a hard power reset, then inspect the air filter and its wiring before considering board replacement.
symptoms: FF shown on the indoor display or remote
Compressor or fan does not start

fixSteps.title: Power reset
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect the unit from power for 5 minutes, then restore power and observe whether the error returns.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the service panel and verify all connectors at the main control board are fully seated and undamaged.

fixSteps.title: Test the suspect component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify resistance or continuity of the affected sensor or component, and compare against service manual specs.

fixSteps.title: Replace the failed part
fixSteps.instruction: Order the matching replacement part for your model, install it in the same orientation, and reconnect all wiring before re-testing.

whenToCallPro: If basic checks do not clear the FF code, an HVAC technician should be called to verify refrigerant pressures and inverter operation.
videoSearchQuery: Frigidaire air conditioner FF error fix

faq.q: What does FF mean on a Frigidaire air conditioner?
faq.a: The unit is asking the user to clean the air filter after a programmed runtime.

faq.q: Can I run my Frigidaire air conditioner with FF?
faq.a: No — most units lock out operation when FF is active. Resolve the fault before continued use.
